voice:
Let your eyes close, and bring your attention to your forehead. Let it smooth out soft and blank.
Your jaw relaxes. Your neck goes loose and limp.
Feel that warmth pour down through your shoulders your arms heavy and still.
Your chest softens and grows warm. Your tummy melts. Your legs turn to liquid, all the way down to your toes.
Your whole body is loose, limp, and lazy — and the deeper your body relaxes, the deeper your mind follows.
Now let that heaviness carry you all the way down. Now let all that lovely weight take you down with it. And that heaviness knows the way from here... let it carry you down.
Sissy Drop.
That's it... sinking through the warm, heavy softness... deeper and deeper.
Every muscle undone. Every thought quiet.
Sissy Drop.
Sinking now... all the way into soft, deep trance. You are doing perfectly... deeper still. Down now... all the way into soft, deep trance... and there is nothing left to hold up. Sinking... soft, and deep, and finished... every last bit of you let go. Perfect.
